title: Ezekiel's Vision of God's Glory

questions.question: In what year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, did Ezekiel see visions of God by the Chebar canal?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:1 (ESV): "In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the exiles by the Chebar canal, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God."

questions.question: Whose exile was it the fifth year of when the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:2 (ESV): "On the fifth day of the month (it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin),"

questions.question: What came out of the north in Ezekiel's vision?
options: A stormy wind, a great cloud, with brightness around it, and fire flashing forth continually
A chariot of fire drawn by horses of fire
A great army of Chaldeans on horseback
A thick darkness with the sound of a trumpet
questions.correctAnswer: A stormy wind, a great cloud, with brightness around it, and fire flashing forth continually
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:4 (ESV): "As I looked, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, and a great cloud, with brightness around it, and fire flashing forth continually,"

questions.question: From the midst of the fire came the likeness of how many living creatures?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:5 (ESV): "And from the midst of it came the likeness of four living creatures."

questions.question: What form did the four living creatures generally have?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:5 (ESV): "And this was their appearance: they had a human form,"

questions.question: How many faces and how many wings did each living creature have?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:6 (ESV): "but each had four faces, and each of them had four wings."

questions.question: What were their legs like, and what did their calves resemble?
options: Straight legs; the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot
questions.correctAnswer: Straight legs; the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:7 (ESV): "Their legs were straight, and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot. And they sparkled like burnished bronze."

questions.question: What were the four faces of each living creature?
options: A human face, a lion's face, an ox's face, and an eagle's face
A king's face, a priest's face, a prophet's face, and a soldier's face
A bear's face, a leopard's face, a lion's face, and a beast's face
A human face, a winged face, a serpent's face, and a dog's face
questions.correctAnswer: A human face, a lion's face, an ox's face, and an eagle's face
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:10 (ESV): "As for the likeness of their faces, each had a human face. The four had the face of a lion on the right side, the four had the face of an ox on the left side, and the four had the face of an eagle."

questions.question: In what manner did the living creatures move?
options: Each went straight forward. Wherever the spirit would go, they went, without turning as they went.
They flew in wide circles around the throne
They marched in a square formation, turning corners sharply
They ascended and descended like lightning instantly
questions.correctAnswer: Each went straight forward. Wherever the spirit would go, they went, without turning as they went.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:12 (ESV): "And each went straight forward. Wherever the spirit would go, they went, without turning as they went."

questions.question: What was beside each of the living creatures on the earth?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:15 (ESV): "Now as I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, one for each of the four of them."

questions.question: What did the construction of the wheels look like?
options: As it were, a wheel within a wheel
Solid gold rims with bronze spokes
Bands of iron covered in fire
questions.correctAnswer: As it were, a wheel within a wheel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:16 (ESV): "their appearance and construction being as it were a wheel within a wheel."

questions.question: What were the rims of the four wheels full of all around?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:18 (ESV): "And their rims were tall and awesome, and the rims of all four were full of eyes all around."

questions.question: What was over the heads of the living creatures?
options: The likeness of an expanse, shining like awe-inspiring crystal
A ceiling of solid gold, like the sky
questions.correctAnswer: The likeness of an expanse, shining like awe-inspiring crystal
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:22 (ESV): "Over the heads of the living creatures there was the likeness of an expanse, shining like awe-inspiring crystal, spread out above their heads."

questions.question: What was above the expanse that was over the heads of the living creatures?
options: The likeness of a throne, in appearance like sapphire
An altar of incense, burning brightly
The Ark of the Covenant, shining with glory
A rainbow encircling a radiant sun
questions.correctAnswer: The likeness of a throne, in appearance like sapphire
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:26 (ESV): "And above the expanse over their heads there was the likeness of a throne, in appearance like sapphire;"

questions.question: What did Ezekiel do when he saw the likeness of the glory of the Lord surrounding the figure on the throne?
options: He hid himself behind a rock
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 1:28 (ESV): "Such was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard the voice of one speaking."

key_verse_text: Like the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud on the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. Such was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard the voice of one speaking.
